caption: The drawing depicts a sofa with ornate decorative features, rendered mainly in black and several shades of yellow and brown. The sofa occupies the upper center of the page and features a curved backrest with scrolling armrests adorned with detailed patterns; the arms and legs have an appearance of carved wood with gilded or golden tones. Below the sofa, there are four detail sketches illustrating specific elements: a front leg shaped like an animal's paw with a feathered wing motif, a side view of the scrolling armrest with detailed carving, a curved segment also decorated with intricate patterns, and a decorative component resembling a stylized animal head with a curled tail. In the lower right corner, there is a diagram of the sofa, showing its dimensions: 3 feet 8 inches in height and 4 feet 8 inches in width. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color.
title: Sofa
